name: Drush Webmaster
description: A large suite of structured, validated wm:* Drush commands (YAML output) for AI-assisted Drupal site management: entities, content types, fields, views, menus, blocks, vocabularies, media types, translations, moderation and search. No HTTP routes.
project_description: Drush Webmaster provides a comprehensive suite of Drush commands (all prefixed wm:*) designed for AI-assisted Drupal site management. Query, create, edit and inspect entities, content types, fields, views, menus, vocabularies, blocks, media types, translations and moderation workflows, all through structured YAML output optimized for AI agents and human operators alike. It exposes a full site-schema discovery command (wm:schema:dump), an entity query language with field conditions and operators, and a YAML export/edit/apply workflow with dry-run validation and versioned history (with revert). Every mutating command is backed by input validators and supports --dry-run, and the module deliberately never shells out to execute arbitrary AI-generated code: the agent chooses and parameterises the provided commands. Two optional submodules add redirect management (drush_webmaster_redirect) and webform management (drush_webmaster_webform). This is a 1.0.0-beta1 pre-release.
